_doc: What the office suite may read from its pinned clones (town-clone/, world-clone/, at test/clone-pins.json's shas), as git sparse-checkout patterns (non-cone: gitignore syntax, a later line overrides an earlier one). POS-652, Darko 2026-10-15 19:51: "sparse checkout 100% ... We should never be checking out the full town clone at this point." Every office pool tree, CI (.github/scripts/suite-clones.sh) and the pool's provisioning (G:/Postmark/pool/claims-lib.mjs) check out exactly these, from this one file; test/helpers/clone-sparse.mjs reads it. MEASURED, not guessed: on 2026-10-15 the whole suite ran on CI with every file it opened in either clone recorded per test file (inotify on both clones, run 38827539430 on the branch pos652/measure-clone-reads): 5,692 files and 3,473 directories, no letter, no MEEPS, PROJECTS or HARBOR file, and no STATE/log/*.meta.json. Each pattern names who reads it. THE GUARD: test/helpers/sparse-guard.mjs (loaded by npm test and the lanes' local runs through --import, by test/fixture-paths.mjs, and on CI by NODE_OPTIONS in every process; a miss in any process a test spawns reds the run) makes a read of a path that is in the pinned commit but outside these patterns throw, naming the path and this file; a directory listing that lacks an entry the commit has throws the same way, unless the entry matches the clone's `unlisted` (an absence measured safe, with its reader). To add a path: add a pattern here with its reader, and the pool trees convert in place (node G:/Postmark/pool/claim.mjs sparse office-N). THE STAND-INS (test/helpers/dev-target.mjs: the dev rehearsal's and tools/sandbox.mjs's scratch clones, the playground's among them) are a different set, made in test/helpers/clone-sparse.mjs § standinPatterns: they run a whole office that writes, so they keep the whole tree except the town's older letters and the world's older STATE/log/*.meta.json.
